title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Payment Terms Schedule: Cut-off, Channels, AutoPay and Credit Balances
content:
Payment, AutoPay and credit balance figures of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards. Every card carries the same figures; each column is the Marlowe & Finch card of that name.

| | Store Card | Store Card Plus | Store Card Elite | Mastercard | Platinum Mastercard | World Elite Mastercard |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payment cut-off time on a business day (Eastern Time) | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 |
| AutoPay change lead time (business days before a due date) | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Credit balance refunded within (business days of the request) | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Credit balance refunded without a request after (months) | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Smallest credit balance refunded on request (USD) | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |

**Payment channels (every card):** online, mobile app, automated phone line, phone agent, mail, in store at a Marlowe & Finch register, and AutoPay.

**AutoPay amounts the cardmember can choose (every card):** the minimum payment due, the statement balance, or a fixed amount.

## Definitions

1. **Cut-off time** — the Eastern Time cut-off (5:00 p.m.) on a business day after which a payment is credited the next business day.
2. **Payment channels** — the channels through which a payment can be made.
3. **AutoPay amounts** — the AutoPay amounts the cardmember can choose.
4. **AutoPay change lead time** — the business days before a payment due date by which an AutoPay change must be made to apply to that due date.
5. **Credit balance refund time** — the business days after a cardmember's refund request within which a credit balance is refunded.
6. **Refund without a request** — the months a credit balance may remain on the account before it is refunded without a request.
7. **Smallest refund on request** — the smallest credit balance refunded on request.

## Points illustrated (hypothetical)

- An online payment made at 16:45 Eastern Time on a Tuesday business day is before the 17:00 cut-off; the same payment at 17:20 is after it.
- A credit balance of USD 0.80 is below the USD 1.00 smallest refund on request; a credit balance of USD 1.00 meets it.
